chunks.text:
Graphic Design (التصميم الجرافيكي) at Middle East University — about the department (department page).
The Department of Graphic Design was introduced as one of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences departments in the academic year 2008/2009, and became part of the Faculty of Architecture and Design in the academic year 2010/2011 (the faculty is now called the Faculty of Engineering & Design). The department aims to become one of the best departments in the Kingdom, with emphasis on preparing talented graphic designers in the fields of printed visuals and modern animation methods in journalism and advertisement, who know the most recent technologies and programming methods related to the specialization.

Graphic Design — department mission (department page).
The mission of the department is to prepare and educate students in various graphic design fields and visual aids such as magazines, newspapers, books and covers, in addition to animation and advertisement campaigns, to achieve planned goals that serve the community.
